This '''spaceport town''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]], in the [[Patriim system/Legends|Patriim system]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was home to the sizable construction crew of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], constructed in Hockaleg's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], in between work shifts.
